subject: Maintainers runway credit amendment
messages:
From: Arjun Patel <arjun@openstewards.org>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: runway credit top-up for OpenStewards hackweek

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you had a great weekend. Quick ask: we just got confirmation that our community hackweek is being extended by three days (more workshops + an extra mentor cohort). We originally accepted the 1,000 credit trial you gave us last quarter, which got us through the initial sprint, but the extension will push us over budget.

Would Redwood be able to provide a one-time runway top-up (5000 credits) or a short trial extension (30 days)? This event is explicitly community-facing — we run workshops for new maintainers and the additional credits will go directly to test/mentor workloads and CI runs.

A bit of context: approximate monthly token usage for the cohort is ~450k tokens; the extra days would add ~120k tokens. We can provide a short post-event write-up and attribution in our sponsor page.

Attached: an event schedule and a breakdown of expected model usage. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks for considering — we love working with Redwood.

Best,
Arjun
Community Lead
OpenStewards Collective

Attachments:
- openstewards_hackweek_schedule.pdf (attachment stub)
- usage_breakdown.csv (attachment stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@openstewards.org>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: runway credit top-up for OpenStewards hackweek

Thanks for the note, Arjun — and congrats on the extension, sounds great. Looping in Marcus for budget approval and Marissa for program ops (to capture any PR/attribution asks).

Quick proposal from our side: offer a 5k one-time credit grant tied to a short outcomes email + logo attribution. If finance has constraints we can instead offer a 30-day trial extension plus a usage cap. Marcus — can you confirm which option is feasible and whether we need a simple agreement signed?

If approved, I'll prepare the credit code and onboarding checklist and send it directly to Arjun (with the attribution language).

Kimberly Park
Program Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
kimberly@redwood.com

On Sun, Jun 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Arjun Patel <arjun@openstewards.org> wrote:
> Hi Kimberly,
> ...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: runway credit top-up for OpenStewards hackweek

Kimberly — reviewed. We can approve a one-time 5,000 credit grant under the maintainer sponsorship program, subject to two conditions:

- 1) OpenStewards provides a short outcomes write-up within 30 days that includes usage numbers and attribution placement.
- 2) We cap any single project at 1,500 credits during the event to avoid large single-job spikes (we can relax if they submit a brief job plan).

I'll attach a quick costing estimate for reference and a draft maintainer agreement that covers the credit terms and attribution. Finance confirms this fits within our partner docket.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Ops (Redwood Inference)

Attachments referenced:
- costing_estimate.xlsx (attachment stub)
- maintainer_agreement_v1.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Patel <arjun@openstewards.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: runway credit top-up for OpenStewards hackweek

Hi Arjun — good news: we can provide the one-time 5,000 credit grant. Terms we need you to agree to (short):

- Use the credits during the June 20–30 hackweek window; any unused credits will expire 60 days after issue.
- Provide a short outcomes email (1–2 paragraphs) and basic usage numbers within 30 days of the event.
- Attribution: add "Powered by Redwood Inference" to the events sponsor section (visual/logo placement).

I've attached the maintainer agreement with the two clauses and a costing sheet Marcus shared. If that looks good, sign the agreement here: https://redwood.docusign.com/MT-OPN-2026-397 (DocuSign link stub). Once we receive the signed doc we'll issue the credit code and onboarding checklist.

If you prefer a trial extension instead (30 days) let me know and we can flip the offer.

Thanks — excited to support the cohort.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Program Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- maintainer_agreement_v1.pdf (attachment stub)
- costing_estimate.xlsx (attachment stub)
